title: Vehicle
description: A vehicle as a protocol subject. Carries the IVID and derived summary attributes only. Authored claims live in Fact records, never here — every summary attribute below is derived from the active Fact set and MUST NOT be written directly. NO OWNER FIELD EXISTS, BY CONSTRUCTION.

ivid.description: IDauto Vehicle ID. Independent of VIN, plate and owner identity; not derived from any of them. >=80 bits of entropy plus a check symbol. Survives re-plating, resale, re-registration, export and import. Never reused. Payload length is bounded to 16-30 symbols so the maximum full IVID string (7-char 'ivid:1:' prefix + up to 30-char payload + 3-char ':'+check = 40 chars) fits the live idauto_vehicles.internal_ref VARCHAR(40) column exactly. v1 issues 26-char IVIDs (16-symbol payload, 80 bits of entropy from crypto.randomBytes(10)); the upper bound of 30 leaves room for a future higher-entropy issuance without a column migration.

merged_into.description: Set when this record was merged into another. Both records are retained; a merge is itself an Event and MUST be reversible.

summary.description: DERIVED from the active Fact set. Present for convenience only. Never authored, never authoritative — read the Facts for provenance.

category_code.description: EU vehicle category: M1, N1, L3, ...

current_plate_ref.description: Plate record with an open interval, if any. A plate is an attribute, never the identity.

not.description: Structural prohibition, stated for readers rather than validators: no owner, holder, contact or personal-identifier property may be added to this schema. Holder association is a separate, access-controlled record.
